verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud SLO docs confirm SLI/SLO definition and reacting when service quality dips, and Alerting supports multi-source queries and burn-style threshold alerts, but the evidence never explicitly names 'error budget' or 'burn-rate alert' as first-class SLO concepts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of error-budget calculation and burn-rate alert rules/templates, and independent confirmation of this specific workflow.
